--------------------------------------------------- ------------- october 31st & november 1st 2026 – feast of all saints sat. 31st 8.00 pm people of the parish community sun. 1st 9.45 am all saints day - pat rooney (month’s mind) huddersfield / carragh, coolaney brother of maure en quinn, carragh / rosary in rockfield cemetery after mass mon. 2nd 10.00 am all souls day mass tue. 3rd 10.00 am daily mass – holy souls wed. 4th 10.00 am daily mass – holy souls thur.5th 10.00 am daily mass – (holy souls) followed by exposition of the blessed sacrament until 11.30 am fri. 6th 10.00 am daily mass – holy souls sat. 7th 8.00 pm tommy mcgowan (months mind) his wife patricia & all the mcgowan, nevin & keogh fam sun. 8th 9.45 am preparation mass for first holy communion / rosary in killoran cemetery after mass big welcome back – to fr. gerry who is returning to duties from this weekend. wishing him every happiness and success in his ministry in coolaney. a big thank you , also, to the eucharistic ministers who provided communion services three days a week for the past while. it i s especially to be welcomed that mass will, once ag ain, be celebrated each day in the parish. thanks to all who help out in any capacity in the running of our parish commun ity. killoran community centre - card games have recommenced on oct. 21st at 9.00 pm. all new members welcome. offertory collection (oct. 24th & 25th) many thanks for your ongoing generosity and support . it is much appreciated. weekly exposition of the blessed sacrament – for the winter months will now take place on thu rsday mornings immediately after 10 am mass, concluding at 11.30 a m. this means no tuesday evening holy hour until su mmer. charity tax rebate scheme – the parish hopes to submit a claim to revenue in jan. 2027 for the 2026 financial year. the scheme allows all registered and regulated char ities (including parishes) to reclaim the tax compo nent of charitable donations made in a given year. if you paytax and have contributed €250 or more, then your donations will already have been taxed. revenue will refund the parish a standard 45 cents for every €1 donated. more infor mation located at exit doors. please take a copy of the green flye r home and, if you can help, fill in the minimal de tails and return. mission sunday october 18th – thanks to all who supported the mission appeal. donations can still be made. blue november offering envelopes – are included in the box of offertory envelopes. they are intended for anyone who would like to make an offering for masses said for the dead throughout november. all the dead will be prayed for, irrespective or an offering made or not. all weekday masses throughout november will be said for the holy souls. for those who would like the names of their dead includ ed, they can put a list into the blue envelope or, alternatively, write on the paper insert of the separate november envelo pes at the doors. there will be a basket in front o f the altar for the envelopes / names. if putting money into an envelope, return it in the offertory collection or hand di rectly to fr. gerry. all donations go to the coolaney priest wages accou nt. please do not put money in an envelope and leave it in the church. dates for your diary sunday, november 1st rosary in rockfield cemetery – following morning mass sunday, november 8th rosary in killoran cemetery – following morning mass sunday, november 22nd service of remembrance of the dead – 5.00 pm wednesday, november 25th general clean-up of the church – from 10.00 am onwa rds – volunteers needed please sunday, december 20th carol service with the coolaney gospel choir – 6.00 pm church rotas – thanks to all who are involved in the various mi nistries, especially at the weekend masses – readers, ministers of holy communion, basket collectors etc. , etc. just a reminder …. if someone on a rota can’t make it, it would be appreciated if others could stand in for t hem on that occasion. congratulations & well done – to all involved in coolaney tidy towns 2026 entry. coolaney came in 3rd place in the county after riverstown (1st place) and sligo town (2nd place). they were also awarded a gold medal for co ming within 15 points of the overall winner of ballinaho westmeath. fantastic achievement. revised traffic plans for outside rockfield church – alternatives are being explored. no final decisi on made. masses can be booked – with fr. gerry directly or through the parish of fice in collooney (071) 9167235. candelabras – are now repaired and back in use. thanks to the parishioner who repaired them so well & so quickly. deadline for submission of news items / mass intent ions - is 12.00 pm on the previous wednesday. in november, we whisper our love to the heavens, ke eping the flame of memory alive for those who paved our way. online newsletter – with additional items can be found on the as the church webcam is located. coolaney
